title: The Paranormal Project
excerpt: Is the Gravenhurst Opera House Haunted?
content:
For 125 years, people have passed through the doors of the Gravenhurst Opera House. Performers. Audiences. Politicians. Prisoners. Town officials. Generations of people gathering beneath the same roof.
But after the audience leaves, the curtain comes down and the building goes quiet… is everyone really gone? This year, we're putting that question to the test and for a great cause - The Gravenhurst Health Hub!

Five independent paranormal investigation teams from across Ontario have been invited to investigate the Gravenhurst Opera House...separately. Each team has been given their own night inside the historic theatre to explore, investigate and document whatever they encounter using their own methods and equipment.
They aren't investigating together. They don't know what the other teams experienced. And on Thursday, November 5, we're bringing them together for The Paranormal Project: a live presentation revealing what each team discovered.

You'll see highlights and evidence selected from five separate investigations and hear directly from the investigators about what happened inside the building.

Did they hear something they couldn't explain?
Did they capture something unexpected?
Did completely independent investigators have similar experiences in the same locations?
Or will five investigations produce five completely different stories?
You get to decide what you believe.

And the investigation is only part of the night.
Come early when the doors open at 6:00 p.m. and explore a Mystical Market featuring 13 Curiosities throughout Trillium Court. Spend your 'Spirit Tokens' to activate an eclectic collection of readings, oddities, local makers, interactive experiences, paranormal personalities and other surprises to discover before the show and again at intermission. Don't forget to bring cash to help us FEED THE CAULDRON! Let's brew up a delicious financial concoction for a great cause.
